subject: ExtRA
source_sentence: Given all review text about a certain product type, our framework , ExtRA, extracts most promi- nent aspect terms in four main steps: first it ex- tracts potential aspect terms from text corpus by lexico-syntactic analysis ; then it associates the terms to synsets in WordNet and induce a sub- graph that connect these terms together; after that it ranks the aspect terms by a personalized page rank algorithm on the sub- graph; and finally picks the top K non-overlapping terms using the sub- sumption relation in the subgraph.
title: ExtRA: Extracting Prominent Review Aspects from Customer Feedback
